description: CreatorOS visual identity system and navigation architecture -- X/Twitter-inspired minimalism, component library, color system, layout patterns, and responsive strategy

design_philosophy.inspiration_rationale: X/Twitter represents the gold standard for information-dense, speed-optimized creator interfaces. Clean chrome disappears so content dominates. Every pixel earns its place.

principle_definitions.minimalism: Remove every element that does not directly serve the current task. White space is not wasted space -- it is a navigation aid.
principle_definitions.speed: Every interaction must feel instantaneous. Perceived performance matters as much as actual performance. Skeleton screens, optimistic updates, prefetching.
principle_definitions.function-first: Aesthetic decisions are always subordinate to usability. A beautiful button that confuses users is a failed button.
principle_definitions.content-density: Creators manage high volumes. The interface must show maximum relevant information without scrolling. Dense does not mean cluttered -- it means well-organized.
principle_definitions.progressive-disclosure: Show the 20% of controls used 80% of the time. Advanced features exist but do not compete for attention with primary actions.

what_it_is: Clean lines with precise alignment grids
Monochrome base palette with strategic accent colors for primary actions
Content-first layouts where creator content is the visual hero
Dense information architecture optimized for power users
Typographic hierarchy that creates structure without decorative elements
Subtle borders and dividers instead of shadows or depth effects
System-native feel -- fast, predictable, no visual surprises
Icon-driven navigation with text labels only where disambiguation is needed
what_it_is_not: Gamification chrome (XP bars, achievement badges, level indicators)
Rounded blob shapes or organic forms
Excessive drop shadows or 3D depth simulation

primary.name: Ink
primary.usage: Primary text, active navigation icons, headings

secondary.name: Steel
secondary.usage: Secondary text, metadata, timestamps, inactive icons

accent.name: Signal Blue
accent.usage: Primary CTAs, links, active states, selected tabs, publish/post actions
accent.note: Signal Blue follows X/Twitter convention. Operator may choose a distinct CreatorOS accent to differentiate brand identity.

semantic.usage: Toasts, validation states, status badges, revenue indicators

dark_mode.strategy: True black background (OLED-optimized), not dark gray
dark_mode.rationale: Creators work long hours. Dark mode reduces eye strain and makes content (images, video thumbnails) pop. Default to dark, offer light as preference.
dark_mode.toggle: System preference detection with manual override in settings

open_questions: Should CreatorOS have a distinct accent color separate from X/Twitter blue?
Should each module have a subtle accent tint (e.g., green for Marketplace, purple for Courses) or remain monochrome?

heading.rationale: Inter is optimized for screens, has excellent legibility at small sizes, and supports the full range of weights needed for typographic hierarchy.

body.rationale: Single font family reduces load time and maintains visual consistency.

mono.usage: Code blocks in courses, API keys, embed codes, analytics numbers, revenue figures

structure.right: Action icons (notifications bell, settings gear, contextual actions)

side_drawer.trigger: Avatar tap or swipe-right from left edge

feed_layout.description: Vertical scrolling list of content cards. Used for Content Distribution, Community posts, Consumer Feed.
feed_layout.x_twitter_reference: Home timeline layout -- full-width cards separated by hairline dividers, no card elevation

grid_layout.description: Multi-column grid of visual items. Used for Marketplace products, Course catalog, Media gallery.

structure.gap: 2px (Instagram-style tight grid) or 16px (card grid with metadata)
structure.aspect_ratio: 1:1 for products, 16:9 for courses, mixed for gallery

detail_layout.description: Single-item detail view with scrollable content. Used for Product detail, Course lesson, Post detail.

structure.sticky_footer: Purchase CTA or action bar fixed at bottom

form_layout.description: Data entry screens. Used for Product creation, Course builder, Settings, Profile edit.

dashboard_layout.description: Multi-widget overview. Used for Creator Dashboard, Analytics, Revenue.

structure.desktop: Mixed grid with featured metrics row + 2-3 column detail grid

metric_cards.content: Label + large number + trend indicator + sparkline

split_layout.description: Two-panel layout for desktop. Used for Community (thread list + detail), DMs, Moderation queue.

variants.name: primary
variants.style: Solid accent background, white text, rounded-full (pill shape)
variants.usage: Main CTAs: Publish, Post, Buy, Subscribe, Save

variants.name: secondary
variants.style: Border accent color, transparent background, accent text, rounded-full

variants.name: ghost
variants.style: No border, no background, secondary text color, rounded-lg
variants.usage: Tertiary actions: Cancel, More options, Settings links

variants.name: destructive
variants.style: Solid error-red background, white text, rounded-full

variants.name: icon-only
variants.style: Circular, 36px, transparent background, hover background surface-overlay
variants.usage: Like, Reply, Repost, Share, Bookmark, More

buttons.loading_indicator: Spinner replacing text, maintaining button width

variants.name: feed-card
variants.description: Full-width, no border-radius, separated by hairline dividers. Avatar + name + timestamp header, content body, action bar footer.
variants.usage: Content feed, Community posts, Activity feed

variants.name: product-card
variants.description: Thumbnail image (1:1 or 16:9), title, price, creator name. Subtle border, rounded-lg.

variants.name: metric-card
variants.description: Label, large number (mono font), trend arrow with percentage, optional sparkline. No border, surface-elevated background.

variants.name: list-item
variants.description: Horizontal row: left icon/avatar, title + subtitle, right accessory (chevron, toggle, value).

variants.name: media-card
variants.description: Image/video fill with overlay gradient at bottom for title/metadata.

variants.name: text-input
variants.style: Border-bottom only (underline style) or full border rounded-lg depending on context

variants.name: textarea
variants.style: Auto-expanding, character count in bottom-right when limit set

variants.name: search
variants.style: Rounded-full, surface-elevated background, search icon left, clear button right

variants.name: select
variants.style: Matches text-input style, chevron-down right, dropdown on interaction

variants.name: toggle
variants.style: 24px height, pill shape, accent when active, surface when inactive

variants.name: checkbox
variants.style: 16px square, rounded-sm, accent fill with check icon when active

variants.name: bottom-sheet
variants.style: Slides up from bottom, rounded-t-2xl, drag handle at top, overlay behind

variants.name: full-screen-modal
variants.style: Full viewport, top bar with close/cancel + title + action button
variants.usage: Content creation, course builder, complex forms

toasts.position: top-center on mobile, top-right on desktop
toasts.style: Surface-elevated background, subtle shadow, rounded-lg, icon + message + optional action link

variants.name: status
variants.style: Pill shape, small (20px height), uppercase xs text

variants.name: count
variants.style: Circular, 18px, accent background, white text, positioned top-right of parent
variants.usage: Notification count, unread messages, cart items

variants.name: tag
variants.style: Pill shape, surface-overlay background, secondary text, removable (x icon)

variants.name: role
variants.style: Pill shape, colored per role type, xs text

avatars.fallback: First letter of display name on accent-tinted background
avatars.online_indicator: 8px green dot, bottom-right, only in community/DM contexts

tabs.style: Underline tabs (X/Twitter style) -- text labels, accent underline on active, no background change
tabs.usage: Profile sections, Content types, Analytics periods, Course sections

empty_states.style: Centered vertically, single muted icon (48px), heading (lg), description (sm/secondary), optional CTA button
empty_states.tone: Functional, not whimsical. No illustrations or characters.
examples: No products yet -- Create your first product
No analytics data -- Publish content to see insights

responsive_strategy.rationale: Creators manage their business on the go. Mobile is the primary editing and management surface, not just consumption.

navigation.tablet: Bottom tab bar + expanded side drawer

feed.desktop: Centered column with optional right sidebar (trending, suggestions)

tables.mobile: Card list (each row becomes a card)
tables.desktop: Full data table with sorting and column controls

icon_system.library: Lucide (open source, consistent with clean aesthetic)
icon_system.style: Outline for inactive, filled for active state
icon_system.open_question: Final icon set choice between Lucide, Heroicons, Phosphor, or custom icon font

animation_and_motion.philosophy: Motion serves function, never decoration. Transitions orient the user spatially.
animation_and_motion.easing: ease-in-out for most; ease-out for entrances; ease-in for exits
animation_and_motion.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion media query -- collapse all animations to instant

skeleton_screens.style: Pulse animation on surface-overlay colored rectangles matching content shape

animation_and_motion.open_question: Level of animation richness -- strictly utilitarian (X-like) or slightly more expressive (e.g., subtle scale on card tap)?

google_stitch_inventory.description: 90 design reference files from Google Stitch UI library. These represent the initial design exploration and need cataloging to determine which patterns were adopted, which were abandoned, and which should inform the canon.

categories.name: Layout References
categories.relevance: Feed, grid, and dashboard layout patterns

categories.name: Component Designs
categories.relevance: Buttons, cards, inputs, modals -- compare against component_library above

categories.name: Navigation Patterns
categories.relevance: Tab bars, sidebars, drawers -- compare against navigation section

categories.name: Screen Mockups
categories.relevance: Full-screen designs for specific modules -- map to 28 catalogued screens

categories.name: Style Tiles / Tokens
categories.relevance: Color, typography, spacing tokens -- compare against color_system and typography

google_stitch_inventory.usage_in_canon: These files are SOURCE material, not canon themselves. The canon defined in this document supersedes any conflicting Stitch reference. Stitch files should be audited to extract any patterns not yet captured here.

screen_to_module_map.description: Maps the 28 catalogued screens to the 16 modules and their primary layout patterns

shadow_system.philosophy: Minimal shadows. Prefer borders and background color contrast over elevation shadows.

contrast_ratio.minimum_aa_large: 3:1 for large text (18px+) and UI components

accessibility.focus_indicators: 2px solid accent color, 2px offset -- visible on all interactive elements
accessibility.screen_reader: All icons have aria-labels, all images have alt text, all interactive elements have roles
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Full keyboard navigation support, logical tab order, skip-to-content link

product_types_visual_treatment.description: Each of the 10 product types has a consistent visual identity within the design system

open_questions.impact: Affects all CTAs, active states, links, and accent usage across every screen

open_questions.question: Icon library -- Lucide (recommended), Heroicons, Phosphor, or custom icon font?
open_questions.impact: Affects all 28 screens, all navigation, all product type visuals

open_questions.question: Animation richness level -- strictly utilitarian or slightly expressive?
open_questions.impact: Affects perceived polish and brand personality across all interactions

open_questions.question: Module-specific accent tints -- should Marketplace, Courses, Ads, etc. each have a subtle color identity or remain monochrome?
open_questions.impact: Affects wayfinding and visual distinction between modules

open_questions.question: Stitch UI inventory audit -- which of the 90 reference files contain patterns not yet captured in this canon?
open_questions.impact: May reveal missing components or layout patterns that should be added

open_questions.question: Dark mode as default vs light mode as default -- confirmed dark or operator preference?
open_questions.impact: Affects first-run experience and brand perception

implementation_notes.css_framework: Tailwind CSS (already in stack) -- all tokens map directly to Tailwind config
implementation_notes.component_framework: shadcn/ui (already in stack) -- override default styles to match this canon
implementation_notes.god_file_risk: routes.ts (53KB) and storage.ts (104KB) are existing god files. Design system implementation must NOT add to them. New UI components go in dedicated files.
implementation_notes.auth_dependency: Auth is BROKEN (P0). Design system work can proceed on component library and layout, but auth-dependent screens (profile, settings, role-based views) cannot be fully implemented until Clerk migration.
